reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model NK04, which is not a recalled model. Only MK04 is recalled, so the unit is not part of this recall.
The date code July 2026 is outside the recalled range of units manufactured prior to July 2025, so the unit is not covered by the recall.
No duplicate claims were found, so no review flag applies.
